classification.difficultyReason: Convert mixed length units before calculating rectangular areas, including a rotated rectangle.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these shapes. Give your answer in the smaller unit.

spec.description: Horizontal unfilled rectangle with four right-angle markers, bottom label 0.34 m and right label 9 cm. Horizontal opposite sides have double ticks; vertical opposite sides have single ticks. Intentional source correction: the source uses one congruence tick on every side, contradicting the unequal adjacent dimensions. The distinct tick styles identify the two equal opposite-side pairs.
spec.mathematics: The side lengths are 34 cm and 9 cm. Opposite sides are equal; adjacent sides are unequal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given dimensions and geometric marks are visible; the supplied area is retained in the answer fields.
